title: 第13章 送去挖矿第14章 拜师方天一
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
两人对峙，强大的灵气升腾而起，掀起了巨大风浪。
三皇子听到他的威胁，冷笑一声：“敢对浅洛动手动脚，我没杀了他就是给沈家面子了。”
听到如此猖狂的话，护卫队再也忍耐不住，就要拔剑相向。
沈离眯了眯眼，最先恢复了冷静，打量了三皇子一番。
‘看他的衣着，应该是大周的达官显贵，如此年纪就有这般修为，印象中也只有那几位。
沈离心中念头连闪，排除法后想到了一人，忍不住试探道：“可是三皇子殿下当面？”
此言一出，护卫队面色齐变，立刻收起了肃杀之气，显然事态的发展出乎了意料。
大周皇族的实力有目共睹，比起沈家有过之而无不及。
万万百姓提供的资源，绝对是难以想象的庞大数字，何况皇室老祖可是传说中的金丹大修士，绝非他沈家可以碰瓷的。
每个境界的后期又被称作大修士，金丹大修士可是有望元婴的绝顶存在，连孤鸿剑派都得慎重以对。
三皇子周子游天赋极佳，深得人皇信任，没有人愿意得罪这样的大人物。
见周子游点头，沈离不由得心中暗骂，‘这两个蠢货，招子也不知道放亮点，什么人都敢得罪。
他感觉自己拿到了烫手山芋，退让有损沈家的威严，逼迫又要和三皇子对上，简直两面不是人。
沈狂涛刚从休克中醒来，听到自己得罪了大周三皇子，浑身抽搐，再次晕了过去。
还是沈云上前一步，指着沈狂涛解围道：“此人和我有一些过节，这才借机会打击报复，沈离队长可以调查一番。”
“哦！
？竟有此事。”
有人给了个台阶下，沈离精神一振，见到丑态毕露的沈狂涛，一脸厌恶道：“这人是谁，竟敢如此行事，简直严重违反了家族规矩，必须狠狠处置。”
有机灵劲的护卫立刻出言道：“这人叫沈狂涛，只有炼气一层的修为，托关系才混进了护卫队，我们早就看他不顺眼了。”
沈青书好半天才从地上爬起来，面露苦涩道：“是我将沈狂涛招进来的，还请队长责罚。”

他现在肠子都悔青了，沈云不光天资卓越，还认识三皇子这样的大人物，他脑子有病才去趟这混水。
‘以后和沈秋划清界限吧。
沈青书内心叹息，觉得此前的见风使舵颇为可笑。
沈离双手环胸，沉声道：“你识人不明，罚俸一年以儆效尤，至于沈狂涛这种害群之马，给我把他送去挖矿，正好最近庚金矿脉缺人了，三年后再把他放出来。”
听到这个惩罚，众人不由打了个寒颤。
庚金矿坚硬无比，挖掘全程都得使用灵力，一天下来铁打的都扛不住，长期以往修为都会倒退，是沈家最残酷的刑罚。
将半生不死的沈狂涛抬了下去，沈离朗笑道：“罪人已经判罚，三皇子对此可还满意？”
周子游没有回答，而是转头温声道：“浅洛你觉得如何？”
林浅洛眼帘一抬，平静道：“就这样吧，别给云弟添麻烦了。”
周子游这才点头道：“我本不愿冲突，实在是那家伙咄咄逼人，请沈离队长代为传达我的意思。”
沈离松了口气，哈哈大笑道：“三皇子客气了，此事是我们有错在先，还请多多包涵。”
一场风波就此平息，沈狂涛幽幽转醒，听到自己要被发配到矿洞，整个人如丧考妣，鬼哭狼嚎。
沈离距离最近，耳膜都被震得嗡嗡作响，直接一巴掌把他拍晕过去，世界再一次清净了。
众人这才发现，沈云不光天赋异禀，背景也很不简单，心中立马将他列为不可招惹的存在。
content_en:
The two faced each other, and powerful spiritual energy rose up, creating a huge storm.
The third prince heard his threat and sneered: "If you dare to touch Qian Luo, I won't kill him just to give face to the Shen family."
Hearing such arrogant words, the guards could no longer bear it and drew their swords.
Shen Li narrowed his eyes, regained his composure first, and looked at the third prince.
‘Looking at his clothes, he should be a high-ranking official from the Great Zhou Dynasty. With such a level of cultivation at such an age, I only remember those few.
Thoughts flashed in Shen Li's mind. After eliminating the method, he thought of one person and couldn't help but probe: "But His Highness the Third Prince in person?"
As soon as these words came out, the guards' expressions changed and they immediately put away their murderous aura. Obviously, the development of the situation was unexpected.
The strength of the Zhou royal family is obvious to all, even worse than the Shen family.
The resources provided by tens of thousands of people are absolutely unimaginable huge numbers, not to mention that the ancestor of the royal family is a legendary golden elixir monk, which is definitely not something that the Shen family can touch.
The later stages of each realm are also called great monks. The golden elixir great monks are expected to have the ultimate existence of Yuanying, and even the Guhong Sword Sect must be cautious in dealing with them.
The third prince Zhou Ziyou is extremely talented and has won the trust of the Emperor. No one is willing to offend such a big shot.
Seeing Zhou Ziyou nodding, Shen Li couldn't help but curse in his mind, 'These two idiots don't know how to show off their tricks, and they dare to offend anyone.
He felt that he had gotten a hot potato. Giving in would undermine the dignity of the Shen family, and he was forced to confront the third prince again. He was simply two-faced.
Shen Kuangtao had just woken up from shock. Hearing that he had offended Prince Zhou Zhou, his whole body twitched and he fainted again.
It was Shen Yun who stepped forward, pointed at Shen Kuangtao, and said, "This person has some issues with me, so I took the opportunity to retaliate. Captain Shen Li can investigate."
"Oh!
? This happened. "
Someone gave him a step down. Shen Li perked up. Seeing the ugly Shen Kuangtao, he said with disgust: "Who is this person? He dares to act like this. He has seriously violated the family rules and must be dealt with severely."
The smart guard immediately spoke: "This man's name is Shen Kuangtao. He only has the first level of Qi Refining, and he got into the guard team through connections. We have long disliked him."
It took Shen Qingshu a long time to get up from the ground, and said with a bitter look on his face: "I was the one who recruited Shen Kuangtao here, please ask the captain to punish him."
His bowels were filled with regret now. Shen Yun was not only talented, but he also knew a big shot like the Third Prince. He only went into this troubled waters because he was mentally ill.
‘Let’s draw a clear line with Shen Qiu from now on.
Shen Qingshu sighed inwardly, feeling that his previous behavior was quite ridiculous.
Shen Li crossed his arms across his chest and said in a deep voice: "You are ignorant, so I will fine you a year's salary as a warning. As for a black sheep like Shen Kuangtao, send him to mine. It just so happens that the Geng gold mine is short of people recently. I will release him in three years."
Everyone couldn't help but shudder when they heard this punishment.
The Geng Gold Mine is extremely hard and requires the use of spiritual power during the entire excavation process. Even the iron can't bear it at the end of the day. Over time, one's cultivation will deteriorate. This is the most cruel punishment for the Shen family.
Lifting the half-dead Shen Kuangtao down, Shen Lilang smiled and said, "The sinner has been punished. Is the Third Prince satisfied with this?"
Zhou Ziyou did not answer, but turned around and said warmly: "What do you think, Qian Luo?"
Lin Qianluo raised her eyes and said calmly: "That's it, don't cause trouble to Brother Yun."
Zhou Ziyou then nodded and said: "I didn't want to conflict, but that guy is really aggressive. Please captain Shen Li to convey my meaning on my behalf."
Shen Li breathed a sigh of relief and laughed loudly: "Third Prince, you're welcome. We were at fault in this matter. Please forgive me."
The storm subsided, and Shen Kuangtao woke up. When he heard that he was going to be sent to the mine, he felt as if he was mourning for his heir, and howled like a ghost.
Shen Li was the closest, and his eardrums were buzzing.With a buzzing sound, he knocked him out with a slap, and the world became pure again.
Only then did everyone realize that Shen Yun was not only extremely talented, but also had a very unusual background, and they immediately classified him as someone not to be messed with.
